about: FinUI presets: every choice FinUI create offers (create/index.html, and bin/finui.mjs init --preset), in the order a preset code spells them (one base-36 digit per axis). The first option of an axis is tokens.css as it stands and sets nothing. Options are only ever appended, never reordered, so a code once handed out keeps its meaning. Colours are #rrggbb or var(--token); the ramps are Tailwind CSS's (MIT). Every chart palette but Dyes (finstats' own) is an ordering of the dataviz reference hues that passes its validator by day and by night, on paper, white, Obsidian and slate: neighbouring series at least ΔE 15 apart (OKLab). Fonts are Fontsource's variable builds (5.3.0) of families under the SIL Open Font License, Latin and Latin Extended, each with its licence in fonts/; Inter and JetBrains Mono are base.css' own.

tokens.--card-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 16%, transparent), 0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 12%, transparent)
0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 14%, transparent), 0 14px 36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 24%, transparent)
